facts.claim: The river Tungabhadra rises near the Tunga in the Gangdmilla peak in the Western Ghats, 15 miles west of Kalasa.
facts.quote: It rises close to the Tunga in the Gangdmilla peak in the Western Ghats, 15 miles west of Kalasa.

facts.claim: The river has 18 dams that supply water to 325 acres.
facts.quote: but there are i8 dams from which 325 acres are supplied with water.
